name: comp-277

frames.best_why: The alert is shown largest, with the heading and both bullet lines fully readable.

tagline: A bordered notice lists every rejected password rule under one red icon.
summary: A multi-line error notice for forms. A faded red warning circle sits beside a bold heading and a bulleted list of the conditions that failed.
appearance: A rounded rectangle with a thin border sits on the dark stage. Inside, a dim red circled exclamation is followed by a bold sentence, then two grey bullet points on their own lines.
behaviour: Static: nothing moves or responds, and there is no way to close it.
demo_content: Heading "Password does not meet requirements:" with the points "Minimum 8 characters" and "Include a special character".
search_phrases: list of reasons a password failed
form validation messages in a box
password rules that were not met
alert panel listing what went wrong
use_when: A single field has several rules to show at once and they read better as a short list.
avoid_when: The heading and both bullets are fixed text, so per-field or changing messages need edits.
customise: The heading and both list items are typed into the file; only border, padding and text colours are adjustable from classes.
weight_why: A border, one icon, two short paragraphs and a list.

a11y.note: The list has proper list semantics and the icon is hidden, but there is no alert role, so it is not announced.

issues: Without an alert role, screen readers will not announce the notice when it appears.
polish_why: Clear hierarchy and simple styling; a plain alert box with nothing distinctive.
title: Error List Alert
